sections.instruction: Rewrite the following sentences without changing the meaning: (Example: There wasn’t anyone in front of me in the cinema. → There was no one in front of me in the cinema.)

questions.prompt: They don’t know anyone in this town. → They know
acceptedAnswers: They know no one in this town.
They know nobody in this town.

questions.prompt: She met no one at the bus-stop. → She didn’t
acceptedAnswers: She didn't meet anyone at the bus-stop.
She didn't meet anybody at the bus-stop.
She didn't meet anyone at the bus stop.

questions.prompt: You told nobody to go with you. → You
acceptedAnswers: You didn't tell anybody to go with you.
You didn't tell anyone to go with you.

questions.prompt: We ate nothing until dinner. → We didn’t
acceptedAnswers: We didn't eat anything until dinner.

questions.prompt: She told no one anything about last night. → She didn’t
acceptedAnswers: She didn't tell anyone anything about last night.
She didn't tell anybody anything about last night.

questions.prompt: She didn’t tell anybody about her plans. → She told
acceptedAnswers: She told nobody about her plans.
She told no one about her plans.

questions.prompt: I didn’t say anything. → I said
The station isn’t anywhere near here. → The station is
acceptedAnswers: The station is nowhere near here.

questions.prompt: I don’t want anything to drink. → I want
We did nothing during our vacation. → We
acceptedAnswers: We didn't do anything during our vacation.
